packages.title: The people row marks the chosen chip with ✓ again, and still fits two rows
brief: Round 2, regression R1C-1 from P131 (now UX-1214, S2). What round 1 did: P131 set `showCheckmark: false` on the people row's three kinds of ChoiceChip in `_PeopleFilter` (App/lib/widgets/project_scope_control.dart, the `chips` list at about :240-264: «Todas» `people-all`, «Para mí» `people-me`, and each `people-<id>` chip), with the comment at :240-241 («No ✓ on the chosen chip…»). Why it failed review C: the choice is now shown by a light teal fill alone, with low contrast against the other chips, so colour is the only cue (WCAG 2.2, 1.4.1 and 1.4.11). And the same «Todas»/«Para mí» chips still show ✓ on Calendar, Tareas and a viewers-only project (the pair at about :199-210), so the component looks different from page to page. Seen in build/project-people-filter-es.png.

Why P131 removed it (its implementer's measurement, which the reviewer didn't have): in Manrope at 2× on 320 dp, the ✓ makes the selected «Todas» about 26 dp wider; «Todas» + «Para mí» then measure 281 dp against the 272 dp available (320 minus the page's 2 × 24 dp), so the default state needs three rows, `_AtMostTwoRows` falls back to the sideways row, and Paul goes off-screen. That would fail P131's first acceptance check (UX-1101, S3). Both requirements stand: the ✓ comes back, and the row still fits two rows. Settled here.
Do 1: delete the three `showCheckmark: false,` lines and the comment at :240-241, so Material's default ✓ shows on the chosen chip, as on the pair.

Do 2, to pay for the ✓'s width: give every chip in the people row, and the two pair chips at :199-210, the same `padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4, vertical: 8)` (one shared const in this file). Material 3's ChoiceChip default is `EdgeInsets.all(8)` (flutter/lib/src/material/choice_chip.dart:370), and its `labelPadding` already drops to 4 at 2× text, so this saves 8 dp per chip, about 16 dp on the pair (281 → about 265 dp). Apply it to the pair too, so the same chips look the same on every page. Don't change `labelPadding`, the chip height, the 48 dp touch target (`materialTapTargetSize`), the Wrap's spacing (8) or runSpacing (4), or the app-wide `chipTheme` (app_theme.dart:152; other chips use it).

Measure before you finish, with Manrope, and write the numbers in a comment next to the existing measurements in App/test/project_people_filter_test.dart and in your notes: the width of «Todas» (selected) + 8 + «Para mí» at 2× on 320 dp, in ES and in CA («Totes», «Per a mi»), against 272 dp. If either language still doesn't fit two rows with this padding, say so in your notes with the numbers. Don't go below 4 dp, don't shrink text, and don't take the ✓ away again: an S2 accessibility failure is not traded for layout.

Update the class comment above `_PeopleFilter` if it mentions the ✓. Re-run the form previews (`flutter test --no-pub --dart-define=WRITE_FORM_PREVIEWS=true test/new_task_form_test.dart`) so build/project-people-filter-es.png shows the ✓ on «Todas».

Don't touch: the semantics labels P131 added (`allTasks`, `commandFindPerson(name)`), the chips' order, `_AtMostTwoRows`, the filter's rules (`projectPeopleToFilter`, `_visible`), who gets a chip, ✓ Tareas completadas in the app bar, and the chip borders' colour (UX-1012, P144, changes `outlineVariant` to `outline` in a later package; leave it to P144). No copy change; no ARB files.
acceptance: ES: on a shared project page with «Ana» and «Paul» as other editors, every ChoiceChip in the people row (`people-all`, `people-me`, `people-<id>`) and the two pair chips on Calendar have `showCheckmark` null or true; after tapping «Ana», Ana's chip is selected and is wider than before the tap by the checkmark's width (Material paints the ✓; it isn't an Icon widget).
The people row's chips and the pair's chips on Calendar all have the same `padding`, EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4, vertical: 8).

Manrope, ES and CA, with «Todas» selected (the default) and again with «Paul» selected: at 2× on 320×640 with «Ana» and «Paul», and at 1.3× on 393×851 with «Ana García» and «Paul», every person chip is hit-testable and lies wholly inside the screen with no drag (P131's first check, still passing).

ES, Manrope, a shared project page with two tasks and «Ana» and «Paul» as other editors, at 2× on 320×640 and at 1.3× on 393×851: the first task row's top is no lower than the value P131 recorded in App/test/project_people_filter_test.dart (P131's second check, still passing).
ES, semantics: Ana's chip still has the label `commandFindPerson('Ana')` and reports selected once tapped; the people row's Todas chip is still labelled «Todas las tareas».
Render: build/project-people-filter-es.png shows ✓ on the chosen chip.
deviceChecks: Phone, Spanish, the largest font, 360–393 dp, a shared project with two other editors: the chosen chip shows ✓, and both names still show without swiping.

packages.title: Deshacer from a voice-made project's page also closes a task opened from it
brief: Round 2, regression R1A-1 from P129 (now UX-1212, S1). What round 1 did: in `_apply` (App/lib/screens/voice_task_screen.dart), when one new project holds the tap's new tasks, P129 pushes the project's page (`projectPage`, about :2990-3007), and its Deshacer (about :3064-3073) closes that page with `navigator.pop()` when the page is on top, and `navigator.removeRoute(page)` otherwise. Why it failed review A: if the person taps a lit task on the Física page while the message is still showing, the task's screen sits above the page. `removeRoute` takes the page out from underneath, so the task's screen, for a task Deshacer has just deleted, stays on top, and the result sheet reopens over it. Inferred from code; rare.

Fix: replace the `if (page.isCurrent) … else removeRoute(page)` block with: pop every route above the project page, then the page itself, for example `navigator.popUntil((route) => route == page); navigator.pop();`, still only when `projectsBack && page != null && page.isActive`. Then the result reopens over the screen under the page, as now. Keep the comment above it, saying the page and anything opened from it close.

Don't touch: when the page opens (`opensProject`), the landing on it, the message, the rest of the Deshacer (changes, projects, the restored result), and the Calendar path. No copy change. P147 also edits this Deshacer, after you.
acceptance: ES: a result with «Nuevo proyecto: Física» and «Estudiar el tema 2» into it. After the confirming tap the Física page is on top with «Estudiar el tema 2» lit. Tap that row, so its task screen opens, then tap «Deshacer» on the message: neither the task screen nor the Física page remains, the result shows again with «Estudiar el tema 2» as a draft, no project Física exists, and no task «Estudiar el tema 2» exists.
ES: P129's check still passes: «Nuevo proyecto: Física» alone, Deshacer with the Física page on top closes the page and the result shows again.

packages.title: Deshacer puts back the filter a landing widened
brief: Round 2, regression R1B-1 from P130 (now UX-1213, S1). What round 1 did: when the app-wide filter hides a just-saved task (a task for Ana under «Para mí», or a task in another project than the chosen one), P130 widens `projectScopeProvider` with `scopeShowing` (App/lib/providers/project_scope_provider.dart:34-59): Calendar's `_land` (App/lib/screens/calendar_screen.dart:120-134, set at :133) and the Tareas root's `_land` (App/lib/screens/home_screen.dart:142-202, set at :199-201). Review B verified that (UX-1001 fixed). Why this is a regression: the save message's «Deshacer» removes the task but the filter stays widened, so the person's own view («Para mí», or «Casa») doesn't come back: «I undid it; why is the calendar full of Ana's things now?»

Rule: when Deshacer takes back every task a landing brought, put back the scope from before that landing, but only if the scope is still exactly the one the landing set. If the person changed the filter in between, leave it. Every user choice of filter creates a new `ProjectScope` object (project_scope_control.dart:58 and :192), so `identical` tells them apart.

Do 1, project_scope_provider.dart: add a small record of the last widening, for example `class ScopeWidening { const ScopeWidening(this.landing, this.before, this.after); final Object landing; final ProjectScope before; final ProjectScope after; }` and `final scopeWideningProvider = StateProvider<ScopeWidening?>(...)` that, like `projectScopeProvider`, resets when the account changes. Add one helper, for example `void narrowAfterUndo(ProviderContainer container, Object? landing)`: if `landing` is non-null, the record's `landing` is identical to it, and `identical(container.read(projectScopeProvider), record.after)`, set `projectScopeProvider` back to `record.before`; whenever the record matched `landing`, clear the record.

Do 2, the landings: Calendar's `_land`, when it widens (the `!identical(wider, scope)` branch), also sets the record to `ScopeWidening(focus, scope, wider)`. The Tareas root's `_land`, when it widens (`!identical(scope, global)` at :199), sets `ScopeWidening(focus, global, scope)`. A landing that doesn't widen leaves the record alone (each Deshacer only matches its own landing). Project pages (`widget.listId != null`) don't touch the record: their own `_team` / `_person` change is local and out of scope here.
Do 3, the three Deshacer handlers call the helper after a complete undo, with the CalendarFocus their save set (keep it in a local):
- the form: App/lib/widgets/task_editor.dart, the `onAction` at about :448-460, after `await notifier.deleteTask(id)` succeeds (not in the catch);

- a capture's plain save: `_save`'s Deshacer in App/lib/screens/voice_task_screen.dart (about :2549-2600), after `restored != null` and `showLocal()`; the focus is the one set at about :2533 (null when none was set, so nothing happens);

- a result with commands: `_apply`'s Deshacer (about :3027-3100), only when `whole` is true and `restored != null`; the focus is the one set at about :3009 (null when the project page opened instead). P146 changed the page-closing lines just above; build on them.
No copy change and no new control. Don't touch: `scopeShowing`, the widening itself, which project a new task goes to (UX-302), the scope's default, the messages, and the result sheet's reopening.
acceptance: ES, 1×, the form: an account (id 1) in a shared project «Familia» with Ana (id 2) as editor, Calendar on «Para mí». Save «Llamar al médico» for Mañana in Familia for Ana; «Todas» is selected; tap «Deshacer»: the task is gone and «Para mí» is selected again.
